Tools built around how a business runs.

narrative.northStar: The Field Notebook, printed on rebase paper
narrative.overview: The site shares a visual family with rebase.team: cool-gray paper, white panels, near-black ink, one lime accent, serif headings over a plain sans body. It is still one person's notebook, not a company landing page. No photography, no section numbers, no eyebrow labels, no hero metrics. Headings carry their own weight.
keyCharacteristics: Serif display (Newsreader, weight 500, tight tracking) against a quiet Geist body
Cool-gray page with white panels for anything that is a list of real artifacts
Lime appears in exactly four places: the primary button, link underlines, the active nav item, and the footer band
Flat by default: borders and whitespace, never shadows

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Lime is the only chroma on the site. Do not add teal, green, or ochre washes, and do not use lime as a text color.

rules.name: The No Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No kicker or label above a heading. If a page needs a stage or audience marker, it goes in a chip below the dek.

rules.name: The Serif Carries It Rule
rules.body: Serif headings are 500, never bold. Content H4 uses Geist 600. Emphasis in prose is Geist 600.

dos: Do keep every page on the same paper, panel, ink, lime set.
Do list real artifacts (playbooks, posts) in panels rather than describing capabilities in card grids.
Do keep long-form reading measure at 66ch.
Do keep the Newsreader optical size axis on, so small headings do not look spindly.
donts: Don't add kickers, eyebrows, section numbers, icon grids, metric blocks, or gradients.
Don't add a second accent color or use lime as text.
Don't use bold serif. Headings are 500.
Don't reintroduce "Powered by" footers, scroll-to-top buttons, breadcrumbs, or share buttons.
Don't use em dashes or double-hyphen substitutes in public copy.
